records.description: Matching cached price records. Each carries its own provenance, which may be older than the snapshot when that record's source last refreshed earlier.

snapshot.description: Provenance of the price cache as a whole at the moment it was read. Present even when records is empty, so a caller can always tell how old the cache is and why the last refresh failed.

cached.description: Always true: this answer is served from the cache. A read path never triggers a hidden network fetch; refreshing is an explicit prices.refresh job.
